episodes.152478: Dropping pressure in the Caribbean along with a ridge over the Mid Atlantic States caused a strong gradient wind over Florida. The strong gradient winds were easily able to mix down to the surface with showers in the afternoon and evening hours causing strong marine gust.
episodes.152618: A strong and moist onshore flow pattern resulted in a large complex of showers with embedded thunderstorms over the Atlantic. As the thunderstorms moved onshore, several produced strong winds gusts along portions of the coast from Brevard County to the lower Treasure Coast.
episodes.152716: Scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms developed in association with a tropical wave extending from the western Caribbean into the Florida Straits.  This tropical wave in concert with a departing shortwave, sparked convection across the local South Florida waters. Furthermore, brisk easterly flow aided a few storms to produce some strong wind gusts.
episodes.152718: Scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms developed in association with a tropical wave extending from the western Caribbean into the Florida Straits. This tropical wave in concert with a departing shortwave, sparked convection across South Florida. Furthermore, brisk easterly flow aided a one storm in becoming strong enough to produce a strong wind gust in Palm Beach.
episodes.153508: Lingering moisture from a tropical wave and very slow northerly winds resulted in slow-moving afternoon shower and thunderstorm activity across most interior and southern PR.
episodes.153819: Occasional gale-force wind gusts in occurred with frequent rain and thunderstorm squalls throughout the Florida Keys coastal waters as a slow-moving tropical wave amplified over the western Caribbean Sea.  The squalls occurred over a period from the afternoon of October 18th through the evening of October 20th.
